Plan a webinar from scratch (sized backward from the business goal), rescue one whose numbers disappointed (score the funnel, fix the broken stage), or turn a past webinar into an evergreen on-demand lead engine. Covers the full funnel: registration, promotion runway, show-up, live engagement, live-to-close, and segmented follow-up. Treats a webinar as a funnel, not an event.

skills.name: cs-webinar-marketer
skills.description: Webinar & virtual-event marketing specialist agent. Use when planning, promoting, running, or rescuing a webinar, virtual event, live demo, workshop, masterclass, fireside chat, or virtual summit. Orchestrates the webinar-marketing skill — sizes the funnel backward from the business goal, builds the promotion runway, designs the show-up and live-to-close sequences, scores an existing funnel to find the broken stage, and plans evergreen/on-demand automation. Treats a webinar as a funnel, not an event. Voice — outcome-obsessed demand operator; refuses to celebrate registrations when nobody shows up or buys; fixes the stage that's actually broken instead of rewriting the landing page by reflex.

skills.name: customer-success-manager
skills.description: Use when reviewing customer accounts for health, churn risk or expansion. Scores health with health_score_calculator.py, churn with churn_risk_analyzer.py and upsell with expansion_opportunity_scorer.py.

skills.name: demo-video
skills.description: Use when asked for a demo video, product walkthrough, feature showcase or GIF from screenshots or scene descriptions. Orchestrates playwright, ffmpeg and edge-tts to render it.

skills.name: DevOps Engineer
skills.description: Builds infrastructure that scales without babysitting. Automates everything worth automating. Monitors before it breaks. Treats clicking in consoles as a production incident waiting to happen. Use when infrastructure or delivery needs automation and observability — e.g., designing a CI/CD pipeline for a small team that deploys daily, or adding monitoring, alerts, and runbooks before a launch.

skills.name: env-secrets-manager
skills.description: Use when auditing .env files, planning credential rotation, chasing a missing env var in production or hardening a repo against leaked secrets. Scans for committed secrets and drift with env_auditor.py.

skills.name: eu-ai-act-specialist
skills.description: Use for EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) compliance work: classifying an AI system's risk tier, planning the Art. 43 conformity route and Annex IV file, or listing obligations by role. Runs ai_system_risk_classifier.py, conformity_assessment_planner.py and ai_act_obligation_tracker.py, citing Articles.

skills.name: experiment-designer
skills.description: Plan A/B tests and product experiments: hypotheses, sample size, priority, reading results. Use whenever the user asks if a test won, how long to run it or what to test.

skills.name: Finance Lead
skills.description: Startup CFO who builds models that survive contact with reality. Handles fundraising, unit economics, pricing, burn rate, and board reporting. Speaks fluent spreadsheet but translates to English for founders who'd rather build product. Use when a money question needs a model, not a vibe — e.g., building an 18-month runway plan with three scenarios, or pressure-testing unit economics and pricing before a fundraise. (For DCF and SaaS-metrics tooling, see cs-financial-analyst.)

skills.name: finance-skills
skills.description: Pick the right finance skill: ratios, DCF, forecasts (financial-analyst), ARR, churn, CAC, LTV (saas-metrics-coach), month-end-close. Use whenever a finance ask is vague.

skills.name: financial-analyst
skills.description: Analyze financial statements, value a company with a DCF, explain budget variance, build rolling forecasts. Use whenever the user asks what a business is worth or why spend missed budget.

skills.name: founder-mode
skills.description: Use for /c-level-agents:founder-mode, or any founder strategy question that hasn't been routed yet. Sends it to the right C-suite advisor or the boardroom.

skills.name: free-tool-strategy
skills.description: Use when considering a free calculator, grader, checker or generator as a marketing asset, before building it. Estimates traffic, leads and ROI with tool_roi_estimator.py and scores the idea for search demand and fit.

skills.name: gc-review
skills.description: Use for /c-level-agents:gc-review, or to challenge a term sheet, customer MSA, IP assignment or regulatory exposure before signing.

skills.name: general-counsel-advisor
skills.description: Legal review of contracts and term sheets (MSA, SaaS, NDA, DPA, employment), IP strategy and regulatory exposure (HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, fintech). Use whenever the user asks if a contract is risky or what to watch in a deal; not a substitute for licensed counsel.

skills.name: grants
skills.description: Use for any NIH funding question ('find grants for my research', 'which NIH institute'). Maps the idea to institutes, study sections and NOSIs via RePORTER, matches mechanisms with mechanism_matcher.py and writes a .docx strategy. NIH only.

skills.name: Growth Marketer
skills.description: Growth marketing specialist for bootstrapped startups and indie hackers. Builds content engines, optimizes funnels, runs launch sequences, and finds scalable acquisition channels — all on a budget that makes enterprise marketers cry. Use when growth has to come before budget — e.g., planning a Product Hunt launch sequence, or choosing which organic channel (SEO, content, community) to invest in first at zero ad spend. (For funnel diagnostics with paid budget, see cs-demand-gen-specialist.)

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up, referencing existing artifacts (PRDs, plans, ADRs, issues, commits, diffs) by path or URL instead of duplicating them. Use whenever the user wants to hand off to a fresh agent, is ending a session mid-task, asks for a handoff doc or a summary of state, decisions and next steps for the next session, or starts a new session that picks up prior work.

skills.name: hard-call
skills.description: Use for a decision where every option hurts (layoff vs down round, killing a loved product). Runs 10/10/10 and regret minimization.

skills.name: incident-commander
skills.description: Use when declaring or running a production incident or outage, or writing its post-incident review. Classifies severity with incident_classifier.py, rebuilds the timeline with timeline_reconstructor.py and drafts the PIR with pir_generator.py. Security incidents: incident-response.

skills.name: interview-mapper
skills.description: Use when coding or making sense of one interview transcript (customer, JTBD, expert, usability, exit). Extracts verbatim-grounded nuggets with extract_nuggets.py, verifies quotes with verify_quotes.py and checks conclusions hold across reruns with consensus.py.

skills.name: intl-expansion
skills.description: Use when expanding to a new country: market selection, entry mode, localization, regulation and regional go-to-market.

skills.name: landing-page-generator
skills.description: Use when asked for a landing, marketing or campaign page as a Next.js TSX component with Tailwind. Scaffolds it with landing_page_scaffolder.py using PAS, AIDA or BAB copy, SEO meta and Core Web Vitals targets.

skills.name: launch-strategy
skills.description: Plan a product or feature launch: readiness score and a phased plan by channel. Use whenever the user is launching soon, planning a Product Hunt day, beta or waitlist, or asks how to launch.

skills.name: linkedin-skills
skills.description: Use for any organic LinkedIn growth request (strategy, profile, posts, cadence, outreach, analytics). Checks it against LinkedIn's rules with linkedin_policy_gate.py and routes with linkedin_goal_router.py. No automation or scraping.

skills.name: linkedin-strategy
skills.description: Build a LinkedIn plan rather than a post: content pillars, positioning, a sustainable cadence, whether to start a newsletter. Use whenever the user asks what to post about, how often, or how to grow.

skills.name: local-seo-manager
skills.description: Use for any local business's Google Business Profile, Maps ranking, service-area pages, citations or review replies, before writing. Checks NAP consistency with nap_checker.py and generates LocalBusiness schema and area pages with its scripts.

skills.name: market-research
skills.description: Use for market sizing (TAM, SAM, SOM both top-down and bottom-up), survey sample sizes or segment scoring. Runs market_sizer.py, sample_size_planner.py and segmentation_scorer.py and never returns one unsourced number.

skills.name: marketing-context
skills.description: Use at the start of any marketing project, or when ICP, positioning or brand voice are missing, before other marketing skills. Writes the shared context file the other skills read and validates it with context_validator.py.

skills.name: marketing-demand-acquisition
skills.description: Use when planning demand generation, paid acquisition across Google, LinkedIn and Meta, or a marketing budget, before allocating spend. Computes blended and per-channel CAC with calculate_cac.py and sets MQL to SQL handoffs.

skills.name: marketing-ideas
skills.description: Use when asked for marketing or growth ideas for a SaaS or software product. Picks from 139 tactics by stage, budget and channel instead of a generic list.
